gate_1_open_axis.claim: FB1: the open tube with its ends at given pressures dP apart equals the periodic tube driven by the body force dP / (rho L), to the solve's tolerance (steady Stokes)

prediction.value: max |u_open - u_periodic| / max|u| at most 1e-9 at CG tolerance 1e-11 (float64)

control.plant: the port faces at full weight (V = 1) in the inner product: the projector no longer orthogonal
control.expected_rate: every run, both the gate's difference and the open_face_projection flag [inference: unmeasured in the spike]

gate_1_open_axis.cannot_discriminate_if: both arms solve the same periodic problem (the open arm's ends not open): checked by the open node's z faces holding nz + 1 values

gate_2_flux_pinned_inlet.claim: FB2: the flux-pinned inlet's face flux equals the inflow's Q(t) at every step to rounding

prediction.value: |q + Q(t)| at most 64 eps of the face's magnitude h^2 sum|w| at every step, both dtypes

control.plant: the law delivers Q x (1 + 1e-3); the oracle reads the nominal Q
control.resolution: the smallest relative flux error caught on every draw: about 1e-12 (float64) and 1e-5 (float32) [guess from 64 eps]

gate_3_windkessel.claim: FB3: the backward-Euler Windkessel's own books close at every step (the work the fluid did on it = its storage's change + its resistances' loss + N_WK) to 16 eps of the step's scale, with N_WK booked and positive

prediction.value: law_identity_worst at most 0.5 of its floor in both dtypes; N_WK > 0 on every run with a moving capacitor

control.plant: a port gift: the law's affine relation uses R_p - g (g = 0.05 R_p) while its books use R_p
control.expected_rate: every run in float64; in float32 every run where the gift's size dt g q^2 is above the floor (the spike's float32 arm drew 1 of 8 above it), so the plant is sized above it

gate_3_windkessel.cannot_discriminate_if: the exchange alone were judged: here the fluid's port work and the law's received work use the same solved flux, so their sum is zero by construction (not evidence); the law's own identity is the gate

gate_4_affine_response.claim: FB4: the step's solution (the solve's plus each unit field times its pressure's correction) is the monolithic solution at the solved pressures: its projected true residual at the solve's tolerance; SF-12's affine case built on it
gate_4_affine_response.case: tests/flow/test_fvm_open.py::test_the_superposed_field_is_the_monolithic_solve; tests/flow/test_field_suite.py's affine case; probe arm fb4

prediction.value: the superposed field's projected true residual at most 10 times the tolerance (float64 1e-8; float32 its floor)

control.plant: the stored unit field x1.1, and x-1

gate_5_identity_open_faces.claim: FB13: IMEX Euler's step identity closes with open faces to 16 eps of the step's scale at every step, the kinetic-energy flux booked as dt rho <C(u), u> under the openings' line, N_proj booked (rounding), in flow where that flux is not zero (a swirl through the ends, a stenosis)

prediction.value: identity_worst at most 0.5 of its floor on every draw, both dtypes
prediction.basis: measured-before (smoke 0.031, 0.106; the spike 1.3e-17 of the scale)

control.plant: an interior gift: a body force on the fluid the books do not see, sized at 4 floors of the step's scale
control.expected_rate: every run, both dtypes; no false alarm in 200 clean draws a dtype

gate_5_identity_open_faces.cannot_discriminate_if: the kinetic-energy flux is zero (a straight tube's Poiseuille flow): the draws carry a swirl and a narrowing so it is not

gate_6_open_flags.claim: the open box's two flags: open_face_projection (N_proj over the step's scale) and port_kinetic_flux (the booked kinetic-energy flux against the face formula's, over their size), each with its line from clean drawn runs and its plant caught on every run
gate_6_open_flags.case: tests/flow/open_cases.py's draws, 60 steps each; probe arms flags_lines, flags_rates

prediction.port_kinetic_flux: clean at most about 2e-2 (the face formula's own error, the spike's 0.74 % on a stenosis); the outlet half cell's convective flux taken at full weight (its factor 2 dropped) above it on every run

gate_6_open_flags.if_wrong: a plant missed on some run is reported with its rate and the flag stays pending, not counted

gate_7_nwk_order.claim: N_WK, summed over a fixed time, falls as dt halves at order 2 (term_orders, summed over three drawn cases a ensemble); a physical loss written into its formula fails every ensemble

prediction.basis: derived: N_WK = (C/2)(Pc' - Pc)^2 is dt^2 a step; measured-before (the spike's 1.83e-3, 9.5e-4, 4.8e-4, 2.4e-4)

control.plant: the distal resistance's loss written into N_WK (and taken from the loss, so the law's identity still closes)
control.expected_rate: every ensemble, both dtypes (its sum flat in dt: ratio near 1)

gate_8_passivity.claim: check (a): every port law's per-stage block has a positive semidefinite symmetric part over draws at physical scales (definite_at_floor); sources exempt

control.plant: the Windkessel with its block's sign flipped

prediction.value: |N_proj| at most the open_face_projection line at two tolerances (1e-8, 1e-6)

outcomes.written: 2026-11-10, after the gates ran; the predictions above are as committed in 9a220f3
outcomes.first_probe: superseded: its draws took the step from the start's peak, and 82 of 200 ran past the CFL line through the narrowing's throat, where the node holds the state, so FB4 read held states (clean flagged 10/40); the draws now take the step from the throat's peak at the inflow's peak, a run past the line is judged by no gate (10 of 200 a dtype still pass it, refused by the node)
outcomes.gate_1_open_axis: held: worst 1.2e-12 (float64) and 2.6e-6 (float32) of the peak over 200 draws, lines 1e-9 and 1e-4; the control is the planes' faces' gradient at a full cell, caught 40/40 each dtype (clean 0/40), range 1.4e-9 and 1e-3 of the end gradient removed. The predicted control (uniform inner-product weights) cannot move FB1: the solve's answer does not depend on the inner product, so it is the projection flag's plant instead
outcomes.gate_2_flux_pinned_inlet: missed in float32: worst 22 eps (float64) and 85 eps (float32, 2 of 190 draws over the predicted 64) of the face's magnitude; the line moved to 256 eps (three times float32's worst), at which Q x 1.001 is caught 40/40 each dtype, clean 0/40, range 3.7e-13 and 1.9e-4 of Q; a further miss, reported by the review: the rate run's clean float32 arm (seeds from 1000) flagged seed 1036 at 1.02 of the 64-eps line. The 256-eps line was fitted (three times float32's worst), and the review found the error growing with the face count and the pressure level: the fix round replaces it with a derived floor (predictions_open_ports_fix.json)
outcomes.gate_3_windkessel: held: the Windkessel's own identity at most 0.065 (float64) and 0.109 (float32) of its floor, N_WK > 0 on 200/200; the port gift (0.05 R_p) caught 40/40 each dtype, clean 0/40; range 5.2e-10 R_p (float64), between 0.01 and 0.1 R_p (float32: 11 of 12 at 0.01)
outcomes.gate_4_affine_response: held: the superposed residual at most 0.13 (float64) and 0.125 (float32) of its line; against a cold monolithic solve 1.6e-8 and 1.6e-5 of the peak (SF-12's case's lines 1e-6 and 3e-5); the unit field x1.1 and x-1 caught 40/40 each, clean 0/40; range 7.2e-7 and 2.7e-3 of the unit field's scale
outcomes.gate_5_identity_open_faces: held: ledger_closes on 200/200 a dtype, identity at most 0.068 and 0.21 of its floor, the kinetic-energy flux not zero on every draw; the interior gift caught 40/40 each dtype, clean 0/40; range 2.7e-11 (float64) and 0.027 (float32) of the Poiseuille gradient
outcomes.gate_6_open_flags: open_face_projection held and is active: worst 3.1e-18 and 2.4e-9 of the step's scale, lines 2e-17 and 1e-8, the planes at full weight caught 40/40 each dtype, range under 1e-14 and 1e-6 of the planes' weight. port_kinetic_flux did not hold: on the draws the planes' net kinetic-energy flux is a median 0.035 of their gross (in and out nearly cancel), so a reading of the net against the face formula's can judge 23 of 190 runs; it is declared pending with that reason (judged clean worst 0.013)
